source_refs.note: Detection of gene linkage: a main subheading of 18.6.1 Gene Linkage, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 101-101.

blocks.text: Gene linkage aur us ki frequency (kitni baar hoti hai) crosses kar ke aur yeh dekh kar parhi jati hai ke bachchon mein mukhtalif phenotypes kitni baar aate hain. Asal baat yeh hai ke parental combinations (walidain jaise milap) ka muqabla recombinant ya naye milapon se kiya jaye.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Gene linkage sirf tab nazar aati hai jab cross se bohat se bachche paida hon. Bachchon (progeny) ki tadaad jitni zyada ho, utna hi zyada imkaan hai ke nateeja aabadi mein linkage ki asal frequency dikhaye.

items: Agar bachchon mein parental aur naye phenotypes barabar 1:1:1:1 ratio mein hon to genes linked nahi aur azad ho kar alag hote hain.
Agar parental milap zyada aur naye milap kam hon to yeh incomplete linkage hai: genes linked hain lekin crossing over se alag ho sakte hain.
Agar sirf parental milap aayen aur koi naya milap na ho to yeh complete linkage hai: genes bohat qareeb hain aur alag nahi hote.
